title: Degree of a constant Boolean function
statement: Let $r\ge 0$, and let $g:\{\pm1\}^r\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function that is constantly equal to some $v\in\{\pm1\}$. Its encoding as a function from $\mathbb{F}_2^r$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$ has algebraic degree $0$.
hypotheses_covered: there is a sign $v$ such that $g$ is constantly $v$
